name: INPUT_DIALOG
description: Prompt shown before the command runs; value exposed via $OMC_DLG_INPUT_TEXT. INPUT_MENU is read only for popup/combo types.

NAME.description: Shown in the menu (localized with LOCALIZATION_TABLE_NAME).

VALUE.description: The choice when this item is chosen; defaults to NAME.

INPUT_MENU.description: Menu items: strings (each shown and returned), or dictionaries with NAME and an optional VALUE.
